kids.t: Verified booking, smooth check-in, and the safari pickup was on time.
Our family enjoyed the spacious room. Airport pickup was easy to arrange.
A relaxing stay. The team helped us arrange an early departure and packed breakfast.
Private transfer from Bugungu or Pakuba airstrip.
1-hour guided walk around the lodge grounds.
